newsitem.title: USA: Helen sets acquisitions, sees sales boost.
newsitem.headline: Helen sets acquisitions, sees sales boost.

text.p: Helen of Troy Ltd said Monday it had acquired the assets of two personal care lines of Dazey Corp of Kansas City and estimates that sales from the acquisition in the fiscal year ending February 28, 1998, will be $25-$30 million.
Included in the purchase are the North American licenses to make, market and sell Dr. Scholl's foot baths, foot massagers and body massagers, it said.
The purchase also includes "hard hat salon" hair dryers and Turbo Spa products sold under the Dazey, Lady Dazey and Lady Carel trade names.
